metadata.title: AI Spending Jitters Weigh on Tech Stocks - WSJ

content.text:
The selloff in tech shares picked up steam Tuesday, with the Nasdaq composite off over 2%.
Stocks opened sharply lower, steadied a bit and then tested their lows on the day in afternoon trading. Intel, Nvidia, Oracle and Tesla remain down 3% or more on the day, following steep losses in big tech stocks yesterday. Chip maker Micron Technology was recently down about 13%, near session lows, helping pull the S&P 500 lower.
